title: W1 Attempt Output
description: Schema for a single model attempt output in the W1 eval pipeline. Raw files written by external gpt-5.6-terra desktop threads must conform to this schema.

attempt_id.description: Unique per attempt; include job_id + attempt index, e.g. component-states-baseline-seed101-attempt-0

executor.description: Production runtime model ID. Must be gpt-5.6-terra for both baseline and upgraded cells.

requested_seed.description: Seed value requested in the job packet. Desktop threads do not guarantee seed isolation; use observed_seed to record what was actually observable.

observed_seed.description: Always null — desktop threads do not expose seed controls.

requested_temperature.description: Temperature requested in the job packet. Desktop threads do not expose temperature controls.

observed_temperature.description: Always null — desktop threads do not expose temperature controls.

skill_source_path.description: Repo-relative path to the skill file loaded for this run. Baseline: .omx/tmp/tastecheck-v1-baseline-replay/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md. Upgraded: skills/<skill>/SKILL.md.

skill_source_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the skill file at skill_source_path. Collector enforces match.

raw_output.description: Full text output from the model. Must not be truncated except when status=truncated.

raw_output_hash.description: SHA-256 of raw_output for integrity verification.

assertions_result.description: One entry per assertion in the scenario.

evidence_fields_present.description: For each required evidence field, whether it appeared in the output.

error_detail.description: Present when status=error. Sanitized error message.

external_source.description: true when this file was written by an external desktop thread, not the pilot runner.

external_source_lane.description: Which lane wrote this file (e.g. 'terra') when external_source=true.
